schema:
CREATE TABLE city (
  Country,
  Latitude,
  Longitude,
  Name,
  Population,
  Province
);

CREATE TABLE country (
  Area,
  Capital,
  Code,
  Name,
  Population,
  Province
);

CREATE TABLE economy (
  Agriculture,
  Country,
  GDP,
  Industry,
  Inflation,
  Service
);

CREATE TABLE island (
  Area,
  Height,
  Islands,
  Latitude,
  Longitude,
  Name,
  Type
);

CREATE TABLE lake (
  Altitude,
  Area,
  Depth,
  Latitude,
  Longitude,
  Name,
  River,
  Type
);

CREATE TABLE located (
  City,
  Country,
  Lake,
  Province,
  River,
  Sea
);

CREATE TABLE mountain (
  Height,
  Latitude,
  Longitude,
  Mountains,
  Name,
  Type
);

CREATE TABLE organization (
  Abbreviation,
  City,
  Country,
  Established,
  Name,
  Province
);

CREATE TABLE province (
  Area,
  CapProv,
  Capital,
  Country,
  Name,
  Population
);

CREATE TABLE river (
  EstuaryLatitude,
  EstuaryLongitude,
  Lake,
  Length,
  Mountains,
  Name,
  River,
  Sea,
  SourceAltitude,
  SourceLatitude,
  SourceLongitude
);
